prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1186; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear driver-side quarter panel shows a long scrape with cracked paint and a dented rear door skin, consistent with the reported sideswipe during a lane change. The damage pattern lines up with the account of how the impact occurred. Repair plan calls for replacing the rear door skin, blending and refinishing the quarter panel, and reconditioning the bumper cover edge. The labor hours requested are in line with the work described. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record, and the invoices submitted do not show any duplicated charges. Estimate is recommended for approval as written.
